title: 第17章 裴家第18章 大馋丫头
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
这次墨家集会是尚书左丞举办的，地点也是在他的府邸。
因为尚书左丞便是出生于中山郡裴家，家族极有权势。
秦末乱世，裴家便已经靠着治水之功崭露头角，到如今的北汉，更是钟鸣鼎食。
家主裴茂官至尚书左丞，而且还是墨家九算之一。
二十年前‘一剑动京城’，被先帝收为心腹爱将的武安侯，也是裴家弟子。
还有一位手掌八百里秦川屯田事务的秦州都督，也是裴茂的族人。
在整个中山郡，就算是太守大人在裴家面前都得伏低做小。
如寿亭侯楚平山，若是没有辞官之前，或许能来。
现在只有一个侯爵之位，还没有资格参加这种集会，裴家也没请他。
宋南烛显然也是第一次参加这种集会，跟在曹茱萸的屁股后边东张西望。
一副没见过世面的样子。
和她相比，沈无名倒是显得淡定许多，毕竟他对这种集会不感兴趣。
更何况，他穿越之前虽是孤儿，但成绩还不错，在高考前就参加过大学的夏令营。
如果没有碰上穿越这种事，他都保送c9了。
曹茱萸出示了邀请函，带着两人步入庄园，进入最中间的园子里面。
这是一个露天园子，不过面积很大。
小桥流水，青林翠竹，还有亭台楼阁，曲水流觞，居然在北方见到了这种江南风光。
“曹大人。”
曹茱萸身为中山四大美人之一，又顶着官场新秀、墨家天骄的名头。
刚走进院中，就有不少人侧目而视，随即又看到了旁边的沈无名，转为怒目而视。

中山郡最近流传着曹茱萸的风言风语，说是看上了有妇之夫沈无名。
如今见她连墨家集会都将沈无名带在身边，众人也信了几分。
随即更是愤怒，抢了他们的女神楚幼仪也就罢了，毕竟是指腹为婚。
可又勾搭上曹茱萸是怎么回事？
“曹大人！”一位中年人走过来，面带微笑，“那边有几位老朋友，见见？”
“好。”曹茱萸倒是没拒绝，转头看向沈无名两人，“你们就在这里逛逛，我很快就回来。”
沈无名无所谓地点头，随便找了个位置坐下，就开始炫面前的吃食。
裴家毕竟是世家大族，东西都不差，色香味俱全，正好他还没吃晚饭。
沈无名想起之前参加夏令营，还去听了一些讲座。
讲座的内容很多都是学术垃圾……毕竟好东西都憋着发大文章。
但那茶歇是真的好。
这墨家集会也颇有异曲同工之妙。
周围虽然有不少达官显贵，不过还是墨家弟子居多。
很多都在互相讨论，或是皱眉沉思，或是写写画画。
哪怕时不时对沈无名横眉冷对，却也没有刻意做什么。
倒是宋南烛第一次来，似乎被这种氛围感染，时不时去旁边凑下热闹。
逛了两圈回来之后，坐在沈无名的旁边，正打算倒杯果汁润润口，才发现已经空了。
整个桌上的盘子干干净净，除了骨碟里面堆积如山，其他都一扫而空。
“沈无名，这是墨家集会，不是美食大赛，你是专门来干饭的吗？”
content_en:
This Mohist gathering was held by Shangshu Zuocheng, and the location was also at his residence.
Because Shangshu Zuocheng was born into the Pei family in Zhongshan County, his family was extremely powerful.
In the troubled times of the late Qin Dynasty, the Pei family had already distinguished itself by its ability to control floods, and now in the Northern Han Dynasty, it is even more popular.
The head of the family, Pei Maoguan, was promoted to Shangshu Zuocheng, and he was also one of the nine fortune tellers of the Mohist family.
Marquis Wu'an, who "moved the capital with one sword" twenty years ago and was accepted as a confidant and favorite general by the late emperor, was also a disciple of the Pei family.
There is also a governor of Qinzhou who is in charge of the Qinchuan farming affairs for eight hundred miles, and he is also a member of Pei Mao's tribe.
In the entire Zhongshan County, even the prefect had to stay humble in front of the Pei family.
For example, Shouting Hou Chu Pingshan might be able to come if he had not resigned before.
Now there is only one marquis, so he is not qualified to participate in such gatherings, and the Pei family did not invite him.
Song Nanzhu was obviously attending this kind of gathering for the first time, following Cao Zhuyu's buttocks and looking around.
He looked like he had never seen the world.
Compared with her, Shen Wuming seemed much calmer. After all, he was not interested in this kind of gathering.
What's more, although he was an orphan before time travel, his grades were pretty good and he attended a university summer camp before the college entrance examination.
If there was no such thing as time travel, he would have walked c9.
Cao Zhuyu showed the invitation letter and led the two of them into the manor and into the middle garden.
This is an open-air garden, but it is very large.
Small bridges and flowing water, green forests and green bamboos, pavilions and pavilions, meandering water drinking glasses, I actually saw this Jiangnan scenery in the north.
"Master Cao."
Cao Zhuyu was one of the four beauties in Zhongshan, and was also known as a rising star in officialdom and a genius of the Mohist family.
As soon as he walked into the courtyard, many people looked sideways, and then they turned to glare angrily when they saw Shen Wuming next to him.
There have been rumors circulating in Zhongshan County recently about Cao Juyu, saying that she has a crush on the married man Shen Wuming.
Now that they saw that she even brought Shen Wuming with her during the Mo family gathering, everyone believed her a little bit.
Then he became even more angry, and just snatched away their goddess Chu Youyi. After all, they were getting married on the fingertips.
But what happened to hooking up with Cao Juyu again?
"Master Cao!" A middle-aged man came over with a smile on his face, "There are some old friends over there, do you want to meet them?"
"Okay." Cao Zhuyu did not refuse, and turned to look at Shen Wuming and the two, "You just hang out here, I will be back soon."
Shen Wuming nodded indifferently, found a seat and sat down, and began to show off the food in front of him.
After all, the Pei family is a wealthy family. Everything is good, and the food is delicious and delicious. It just so happens that he hasn't had dinner yet.
Shen Wuming remembered that he had attended a summer camp before and attended some lectures.
A lot of the content of the lectures is academic rubbish... After all, good things are all held back to be published in big articles.
But the tea break was really good.
This Mohist gathering is also quite similar in approach and approach.
Although there were many dignitaries and dignitaries around, most of them were disciples of the Mohist family.
Many of them were discussing with each other, frowning in thought, or writing and drawing.
Even though he was rude to Shen Wuming from time to time, he didn't do anything deliberately.
On the contrary, it was Song Nanzhu's first time here, and he seemed to be infected by this atmosphere, and went to join in the fun from time to time.
After walking around for two times, I came back and sat next to Shen Wuming. I was about to pour a glass of juice to moisten my mouth, only to find that it was empty.
The plates on the entire table were clean, and except for the pile of bone plates, everything else had been swept away.
"Shen Wuming, this is a Mo family gathering, not a food competition. Are you here specifically to cook?"
